name: Xanthos
description: A steadfast soldier of the squad who is split in two by a minotaur's axe.

timeline.summary: The squad finds nine beheaded, butchered Akroans in the pass, including Captain Eumalos, and Xanthos identifies minotaur tracks.
timeline.quote: There were nine Akroans lying on the ground, their bodies already bloating in the heat.

timeline.summary: Xanthos is split from shoulder to thigh by a minotaur's axe while protecting Haemon.
timeline.quote: The axe fell, and split him from shoulder to thigh.

pages_say.description: A steadfast soldier of the squad who is split in two by a minotaur's axe.
